labels: Pick Training Sample, and Corresponding Label

layout.arrangement: Slide number in a yellow circle at the top-right corner. A large flowchart enclosed by a thin red-bordered rectangle occupies the center of the slide. The flow runs generally top-to-bottom: a vertical chain of process rectangles at the top, decision diamonds in the middle, loop-back arrows on the left and bottom, and termination boxes at the bottom and right.

layout.hierarchy: The flowchart shapes dominate the slide. Process rectangles are wide and horizontally centered; decision diamonds are narrower. All shape text is centered and similar in size. The red outer border and red entry/exit arrows provide visual accent. The yellow slide-number circle is small and sits outside the border.

visual_elements.description: A backpropagation-style algorithm flowchart inside a red-bordered container. Nodes and connections, in order: (1) Top-center pink rectangle 'Initialization (Random Weights)' with a red arrow pointing down into its top edge. (2) Down arrow to light-green rectangle 'Pick Training Sample, and Corresponding Label'. (3) Down arrow to light-yellow rectangle 'Go Forward, Calculate Output'. (4) Down arrow to light-yellow rectangle 'Go Backward, Update weights'. (5) Down arrow to light-orange diamond 'Last Sample ?'. From this diamond: a 'NO' arrow exits right, travels down and left to the 'Pick First Sample again' box; a 'Yes' arrow exits downward to light-orange diamond 'Stop criteria is reached'. From 'Stop criteria is reached': a 'Yes' arrow exits right to bright-green rectangle 'Stop' (with a red down arrow below it); a 'NO' arrow exits left to light-orange diamond 'Max Iteration is reached'. From 'Max Iteration is reached': a 'Yes' arrow exits downward to light-red rectangle 'Stop with FAIL' (with a red down arrow below it); a 'NO' arrow exits left to pink rectangle 'Pick First Sample again'. From 'Pick First Sample again' an arrow travels up and curves right, entering the left side of 'Go Forward, Calculate Output'.

typography_notes: Sans-serif typeface (appears to be Arial or Calibri). All text is centered within its shape. Process boxes use sentence case. Decision diamonds use sentence case with a space before the question mark. Arrow labels are small; 'NO' is uppercase and 'Yes' is title case. The slide number is bold black text inside a yellow circle.
animation_state: Static schematic; no build or reveal animation is visible.
recreation_brief: Set the slide background to white.
Add a yellow-filled circle at the top-right corner with bold black text '23' centered inside it.
Draw a large rectangle with a red outline and no fill (or white fill) covering most of the slide to act as the flowchart container.
Place a pink-filled rectangle near the top-center with the text 'Initialization (Random Weights)'. Add a red arrow pointing downward into its top edge from just above the box.
Below it, place a light-green rectangle with 'Pick Training Sample, and Corresponding Label' and connect it downward with a black arrow.
Below that, place a light-yellow rectangle with 'Go Forward, Calculate Output' and connect it downward with a black arrow.
Below that, place a second light-yellow rectangle with 'Go Backward, Update weights' and connect it downward with a black arrow.
Below that, place a light-orange diamond with 'Last Sample ?' and connect it downward with a black arrow.
From the right vertex of the 'Last Sample ?' diamond, draw an arrow labeled 'NO' that goes right, then down, then left to the left-side box 'Pick First Sample again'.
From the bottom vertex of 'Last Sample ?', draw an arrow labeled 'Yes' down to a light-orange diamond 'Stop criteria is reached'.
From the right vertex of 'Stop criteria is reached', draw an arrow labeled 'Yes' to a bright-green rectangle 'Stop'. Add a red arrow pointing down from beneath 'Stop'.
From the left vertex of 'Stop criteria is reached', draw an arrow labeled 'NO' to a light-orange diamond 'Max Iteration is reached'.
From the bottom vertex of 'Max Iteration is reached', draw an arrow labeled 'Yes' down to a light-red rectangle 'Stop with FAIL'. Add a red arrow pointing down from beneath 'Stop with FAIL'.
From the left vertex of 'Max Iteration is reached', draw an arrow labeled 'NO' to the pink rectangle 'Pick First Sample again'.
From 'Pick First Sample again', draw an arrow that goes upward and curves to the right, entering the left side of 'Go Forward, Calculate Output'.
Ensure every text element is centered in its shape, use a sans-serif font, and keep arrow labels small and legible.
